description: geoserver.055055.it: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.055055.it. Coverage: the area served by geoserver.055055.it. The listing groups 13 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: PCCA Bagno a Ripoli - Fasce di rispetto delle strade; Base cartografica (rete stradale) - PSI - Unione Montana dei Comuni de; Periodizzazione delle strade - Piano Strutturale del Comune di Bagno a; Classificazione delle strade - Piano Strutturale del Comune di Bagno a. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
